review: independent read-only review: OK. A window blt matched no earlier permit case and touched no counter beyond requests/lastRequest; both paths run the same front-service core; the three blt sources all clear word 0x455608, always a backbuffer surface, so rectangle() yields no window and nothing is presented; no callback into the Host, driver, session or platform; errors leave the same exchange state; receipts retain the same resources. Acted on: comments and the design note describe the wider scope; the side-by-side test records the display's operation count.
